anchored_wall.title: Anchored excavation
anchored_wall.description: Ground anchor design: free length, bond length, tendon selection and design, test and lock-off loads.
anchored_wall.design.heading: Anchor design
anchored_wall.check.overburden: Minimum cover over the bond zone centre
anchored_wall.warning.bond_length_exceed: Bond length {bond_length} m; capacity gain beyond about {typical_max} m is not reliable (GEC-4 5.3.6).
anchored_wall.warning.inclination_outsid: Inclination {inclination}° is outside the usual GEC-4 range of {min}°–{max}°.
anchored_wall.warning.overburden_low: Cover over the bond zone centre is {depth} m; at least {required} m is required (GEC-4 5.3.7).
anchored_wall.warning.phi_zero_wedge: φ′ = 0: failure surface taken at 45°; the GEC-4 method is for cohesionless soil.
anchored_wall.assumption.beyond_wedge_de: The bond zone starts {value} m beyond the failure surface, measured normal to the surface (GEC-4 figure 37a: χ = 1.5 m or 0.2H, whichever is greater).
anchored_wall.assumption.wedge_origin_at: The failure surface starts at the excavation base corner (GEC-4 5.3.2).
anchored_wall.assumption.level_ground_ve: Level retained ground and a vertical wall face are assumed; sloping ground is not supported yet.
anchored_wall.warning.strand_count_not_i: {count} strands is not listed in GEC-4 Table 10; capacity is taken as a multiple of one strand.
anchored_wall.warning.test_factor_below_: Test load factor {value} is below the GEC-4 value of 1.33.
anchored_wall.warning.limit_above_gec4: The {limit} load limit {value} exceeds the GEC-4 limit (0.6 / 0.7 / 0.8 SMTS).
anchored_wall.warning.min_free_length_be: Minimum unbonded length {value} m is below the GEC-4 minimum of {gec4} m.
anchored_wall.warning.safety_factor_belo: FS {value} is below the GEC-4 guidance of {guidance}.
anchored_wall.warning.transfer_load_unre: No source was given for the load transfer / bond value; presumptive values must be verified by anchor tests.
anchored_wall.assumption.transfer_load_r: Load transfer value source: {ref} (preliminary design; verify by anchor tests).
anchored_wall.assumption.gec4_test_facto: Maximum test load = {value} × design load (GEC-4 pp. 75-77).
anchored_wall.assumption.gec4_tendon_lim: Tendon limits 0.6 / 0.7 / 0.8 SMTS (design / lock-off / test), GEC-4 p. 77.
anchored_wall.assumption.overburden_not_: Rock anchor: the 4.5 m cover rule (GEC-4 5.3.7, for soil anchors) is not checked.
anchored_wall.warning.passive_factor_uni: No factor of safety on the passive resistance (passive factor 1.0).
anchored_wall.warning.embedment_below_pr: The design embedment extends below the soil profile.
anchored_wall.warning.cohesion_ignored: Effective cohesion is ignored in the sand envelope.
anchored_wall.assumption.soldier_passive: Soldier piles: passive width {width} m per pile at {spacing} m spacing (ratio {ratio}); active pressure acts on the full spacing.
anchored_wall.assumption.surcharge_incli: Surcharge given per inclined surface area; {q_h} kPa per horizontal projection.
anchored_wall.assumption.free_earth_supp: One anchor level: free earth support on the actual active and passive pressures (same solver as the sheet pile module).
anchored_wall.assumption.depth_increase_: Embedment increase not given: D = D0 (free earth support, no increase).
Embedment increase not given: D = D0 (1 + {value}).
anchored_wall.assumption.apparent_envelo: Apparent pressure envelope ({kind}), level ground: FHWA GEC-4 5.2.4–5.2.6 (sand and stiff clay trapezoid, figures 24 and 27; soft clay figure 23c). The method is empirical.
anchored_wall.assumption.envelope_source: The envelope shapes and the hinge method were checked against a course summary of Peck's diagrams, not the original figures; verify before design use.
anchored_wall.assumption.load_method_hin: Anchor loads by the hinge method: hinges at every anchor except the first; bending moments from the same model.
anchored_wall.assumption.load_method_tri: Anchor loads by the tributary method (mid-points between supports); bending moments still from the hinge model.
anchored_wall.assumption.embedment_from_: Embedment: moment equilibrium about the toe under the base reaction R_B and the net pressure below the base (passive divided by the given factor of safety; where smaller, the passive pressure from tan φ′ and c′ divided by that factor is used, USACE EM 1110-2-2504 5-2d). This is deeper than the GEC-4 5.5.3 force criterion.
anchored_wall.assumption.sand_surcharge_: Sand envelope: the surcharge adds a uniform Ka q over the full height.
anchored_wall.assumption.stiff_clay_coef: Stiff clay envelope ordinate p = {value}·γH (chosen by the user, GEC-4 figure 27 range 0.2–0.4); trapezoidal shape.
anchored_wall.assumption.stiff_clay_bott: The bottom ramp of the stiff clay envelope is omitted (conservative).
anchored_wall.assumption.soft_clay_m_uni: Soft clay envelope γ H - 4 Su (m = 1).
anchored_wall.assumption.ei_not_used: EI is stored but not used; deflections are not computed.
anchored_wall.assumption.no_section_desi: No steel or concrete section design: shear and moment demands are reported, M/W is compared with a given stress only.
anchored_wall.assumption.anchor_design_n: Anchor design inputs not given: anchor loads only, no free or bond length.
anchored_wall.error.envelope_sloping_gro: The apparent pressure envelope is for level ground; use a single anchor level for sloping ground.
anchored_wall.error.envelope_mixed_layer: Sand and clay layers within the excavation height: the apparent pressure envelope needs one soil type.
anchored_wall.error.envelope_water_in_cu: Groundwater above the excavation base is not covered by the apparent pressure envelope.
anchored_wall.error.envelope_clay_surcha: Surcharge on clay is not covered by the apparent pressure envelope.
anchored_wall.error.missing_soil_paramet: Layer {layer} has no design value for {parameter}.
anchored_wall.error.no_embedment_resista: The soil below the excavation base cannot balance the base reaction within the profile (net pressure not resisted, e.g. undrained clay with γH > 4Su, or profile too shallow). GEC-4 5.5.3 / appendix C: in weak ground use ≈ 0.2H embedment, design the wall as a cantilever from the lowest anchor and add R to the lowest anchor; this path is not in the program and must be calculated separately.
anchored_wall.error.layer_behaviour_mism: A layer's drained/undrained behaviour differs from the drainage setting; mixed profiles are not supported.
anchored_wall.error.non_positive_anchor_: The hinge model gives a zero or compressive anchor load; change the anchor levels or use the tributary method.
anchored_wall.warning.passive_width_capp: Passive width exceeds the pile spacing; the passive ratio is capped at 1 (no extra width or arching benefit).
anchored_wall.warning.anchor_design_leve: Anchor design assumes level ground behind the wall; the sloping ground is not included in the failure wedge.
anchored_wall.assumption.toe_force_not_b: Embedment is from moment equilibrium only; the toe force residual {value} kN/m is not balanced and is excluded from the shear maximum.
anchored_wall.analysis.heading: Anchored excavation support
anchored_wall.analysis.intro: Anchor loads from the FHWA GEC-4 apparent pressure envelopes (single level also by free earth support, the larger governs); embedment, internal forces, basal heave in clay and optionally the anchor design of every level. External stability must be checked separately.
anchored_wall.design.intro: Design one ground anchor (GEC-4): free length, bond length, tendon, lock-off and test loads. Safety factor, load transfer and lock-off ratio are never assumed; GEC-4 limits and minimum lengths are shown as assumptions, and table values are suggestions only.
anchored_wall.status.stale_edited: The inputs were edited after the last run. Run again to refresh the result shown below.
anchored_wall.status.stale_stored: The stored result no longer matches its inputs or its soil source. Run again.
anchored_wall.input.backfill_slope_singl: Sloping ground: single anchor level only; enter 0 with several levels.
anchored_wall.input.passive_factor_hint: Divisor on passive resistance, ≥ 1. GEC-4 5.5.3 suggests 1.5; no default.
anchored_wall.input.depth_increase_hint: Empty: 0 for one level, 0.2 for several
anchored_wall.input.ei_hint: Stored only; deflections are not computed
anchored_wall.input.no_profiles: No soil profiles in the project
anchored_wall.input.design_anchors: Design the anchors of every level
anchored_wall.input.design_anchors_hint: Needs the engineering inputs below; nothing is assumed.
anchored_wall.input.transfer_mode_tau: Bond stress τ_ult and hole diameter
anchored_wall.input.transfer_load_ref_hi: Echoed in the result and report
anchored_wall.input.load_mode_horizontal: Horizontal load per metre and spacing
anchored_wall.soil.copy_note: The analysis keeps its own copy of the profile; the project profile is not changed.
anchored_wall.soil.stale: The project profile this copy came from has changed or been deleted.
anchored_wall.soil.gaps: Layers without the design value the analysis needs (φ′ or Su): {layers}
anchored_wall.missing.title: Required inputs are missing
anchored_wall.missing.level_depth_range: Level {n}: anchor must be above the excavation base
anchored_wall.missing.head_depth_range: Anchor head must be above the excavation base
anchored_wall.reference.note: Suggestions only. Nothing is applied until you press Use; verify presumptive values by anchor tests.
anchored_wall.reference.defaults: Minimum free length: {strand} m strand, {bar} m bar. {source}
anchored_wall.result.title: Result
anchored_wall.result.tendon_detail: Tendon capacity {capacity} kN, design utilisation {util}, governed by {governing}. Source: {source}
anchored_wall.report.envelope: Apparent pressure envelope ({kind}): p_max = {p} kPa, total thrust {thrust} kN/m.
anchored_wall.report.design_problems: Anchor design could not be completed
anchored_wall.warning.external_stability: External (global) stability and deep-seated (Kranz) failure are not checked. Analyse slip surfaces passing behind and through the anchors separately by limit equilibrium; GEC-4 5.8.3 requires FS ≥ 1.3 (1.5 for critical permanent works).
anchored_wall.warning.basal_heave_low: Basal heave factor of safety {fs} is below the required {required} (GEC-4 5.8.2.2). Wall loads increase; a more rigorous method (limit equilibrium or Henkel) is needed and this result must not be used for design as it stands.
anchored_wall.warning.envelope_check_not: The comparison with the GEC-4 apparent pressure envelope was not possible ({reason}); anchor load and moment are from free earth support only. Check the envelope load separately.
anchored_wall.warning.toe_force_not_bala: Embedment comes from moment equilibrium about the toe (deeper than the GEC-4 5.5.3 force criterion, on the safe side). A toe force residual of {value} kN/m is not balanced and is not included in the shear maximum; assess it separately for the embedded section.
anchored_wall.warning.anchor_wedge_simpl: The anchor free length uses the 45° + φ′/2 planar wedge. Per GEC-4 5.3.2 this applies to uniform cohesionless soil with a level surface; with layering, clay or surcharge find the critical surface separately by trial wedge / limit equilibrium.
anchored_wall.warning.vertical_load_not_: The vertical anchor components put {per_m} kN/m ({per_member} kN per member) of axial load on the wall; toe and shaft bearing capacity of the piles/sheets (GEC-4 5.6) is not checked.
anchored_wall.warning.stiff_clay_low_tot: The stiff clay envelope total load {total} kN/m is at or below 4H² = {limit} kN/m. GEC-4 5.2.5: for critical temporary walls, performance data from similar ground must show that such an envelope has been used successfully.
anchored_wall.warning.bond_length_above_: Bond length {bond_length} m exceeds the given maximum {limit} m.
anchored_wall.warning.min_bond_length_be: The given minimum bond length {value} m is below the GEC-4 minimum {gec4} m (appendix E, 3B).
anchored_wall.warning.anchor_spacing_bel: Horizontal anchor spacing {spacing} m is below the GEC-4 figure 37b minimum of {minimum} m (group effects, drilling deviation).
anchored_wall.assumption.basal_heave_nc_: Basal heave by two mechanisms, the smaller FS governs: eq. 37 FS = Nc·Su,b/(γH + q) with depth-dependent Nc; eq. 34–36 FS = Nc₀·Su,b/(γH + q − Su·H/B′) with Nc without depth credit (H/B = 0) because the side shear is counted. Nc is the smaller of Skempton (1951) 5(1 + 0.2H/B)(1 + 0.2B/L) and the value digitised from GEC-4 figure 51c. Required FS: temporary 1.5, permanent 2.5.
anchored_wall.assumption.basal_heave_lon: Excavation length L not given: long cut (B/L = 0), lowest Nc used.
anchored_wall.assumption.anchor_load_fro: Single level: anchor load {envelope} kN/m from the GEC-4 envelope with the hinge method and {free_earth} kN/m from free earth support; the larger (envelope) is used.
anchored_wall.assumption.anchor_load_fre: Single level: anchor load {free_earth} kN/m from free earth support and {envelope} kN/m from the GEC-4 envelope; the larger (free earth support) is used.
anchored_wall.assumption.moment_from_env: Maximum moment from the GEC-4 envelope ({envelope} kNm/m); free earth support gave {free_earth} kNm/m. The diagrams show the free earth support model.
anchored_wall.assumption.front_water_def: Front water level not given: the deeper of the excavation base and the groundwater level is used.
anchored_wall.assumption.stiff_clay_min_: The stiff clay envelope total load is raised to the GEC-4 minimum 3H² = {total} kN/m (5.2.5).
anchored_wall.assumption.stiff_clay_long: Permanent works: 0.65·Ka·γH² = {total} kN/m with the fully softened drained φ′ = {phi}° is larger and is used (GEC-4 5.2.5).
Permanent works: the long-term total load with drained φ′ = {phi}° was checked; the short-term envelope is larger.
anchored_wall.assumption.stiff_clay_temp: The stiff clay envelope is for temporary conditions: controlled short duration and no free water (GEC-4 5.2.5). Otherwise use the permanent (drained) envelope.
anchored_wall.assumption.soft_clay_trans: Soft to medium clay, Ns = {ns} (4 < Ns < 5.14): Ka = 0.22 (GEC-4 5.2.6).
anchored_wall.assumption.soft_clay_henke: Soft to medium clay, Ns = {ns} ≥ 5.14: Ka from Henkel's equation (GEC-4 eq. 12), failure surface depth d = {d} m.
anchored_wall.assumption.soft_clay_ka_fl: Henkel Ka = {ka} is raised to the 0.22 floor (GEC-4 figure 29 transition value).
anchored_wall.assumption.min_bond_length: Minimum bond length {value} m ({ground}, {tendon}) applied (GEC-4 appendix E, 3B).
anchored_wall.error.stiff_clay_permanent: Permanent walls in stiff clay need the fully softened drained φ′ of every retained layer (GEC-4 5.2.5 long-term check).
anchored_wall.error.henkel_depth_missing: Soft clay, Ns = {ns} ≥ 5.14: enter the Henkel failure surface depth d (GEC-4 eq. 12, figure 28).
anchored_wall.missing.passive_factor: Passive factor of safety (≥ 1; GEC-4 suggests 1.5)
anchored_wall.missing.backfill_slope_mul: Ground slope must be 0 with several anchor levels
anchored_wall.section.clay: Clay: basal heave and envelope inputs
anchored_wall.input.clay_hint: GEC-4 5.2.5–5.2.6 and 5.8.2: the envelope is chosen from Ns = γH/Su,b and the basal heave factor of safety is computed.
anchored_wall.input.stiff_layer_depth: Depth of a stiff layer below the base D (m)
anchored_wall.input.henkel_depth_hint: Soft clay with Ns ≥ 5.14; empty: B′ (B/√2 or the stiff layer depth) (GEC-4 figure 28)
anchored_wall.input.stiff_clay_coefficie: Stiff clay (Ns ≤ 4): p = coefficient·γH; choose from experience (GEC-4 5.2.5)
anchored_wall.status.stale_soil: The source soil profile has changed; the result is out of date. Reload the soil and run again.
anchored_wall.check.basal_heave: Basal heave: required FS ≤ computed FS
anchored_wall.report.basal_heave: Basal heave (GEC-4 5.8.2.2): FS = {fs} (required {required}); Nc = {nc}, Su,b = {su} kPa, B′ = {b} m.
anchored_wall.warning.henkel_depth_below: Henkel failure depth d = {d} m is smaller than the basal heave depth B′ = {b_eff} m; a smaller d lowers Ka (unconservative). d should be the depth to a firm stratum (GEC-4 figure 28).
anchored_wall.assumption.ns_from_lowest_: Ns = γH/Su,b with Su,b the lowest Su between the base and B′ below it (GEC-4 eq. 9 says average; the lowest is conservative and may switch the envelope from stiff to soft clay).
anchored_wall.warning.basal_profile_shor: The soil profile does not reach the basal heave depth ({depth} m); Su,b comes only from the profile layers. A weaker clay deeper down would be missed: extend the profile or enter the stiff layer depth.
